principle: CLOUD = think (design/plan/audit/review/learn). LOCAL GPU = do (worker/arm/coder/implementer/vision/organizer/test-L1/db/sim). Goal: minimize cloud tokens.
why_group_orchestrators_cannot_fan_out: Subagents have NO task tool (they are mode:subagent; only IT Leader / mode:primary|all agents have it). FAN-OUT MUST COME FROM THE PRIMARY AGENT.
fanout_owner: primary (IT Leader / cloud LLM) - the only agent with the task tool

model_set.decision: MINIMUM VIABLE - 6 roles covered by REUSE with 4 models

CLOUD_LLM.token_policy: minimal - receive artifact paths + summaries, never bulk content

LOCAL_GPU.token_policy: unlimited local - this is where tokens are SAVED
LOCAL_GPU.traffic_design: ONE model resident at a time (OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=5m, OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1, OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1); full 24GB VRAM transfers to the active role.

task_type_to_route.audit|review|verdict: LOCAL gathers evidence -> CLOUD_LLM synthesizes verdict

fanout_protocol: 2. Primary classifies each workstream: THINK (cloud) vs DO (local).
3. Primary calls task(subagent_type=<specialist>) directly - one call per workstream.
5. LOCAL agents write artifacts to disk; they return ONLY paths + status.
6. Primary (cloud) reads artifact paths, synthesizes design/plan/verdict/lesson.
7. Learning recorded; governance unchanged by learning without approval.
hard_rules: Cloud receives PATHS + SUMMARIES, never bulk file contents.
Local models use the bridge for tools; never assume native tool calls.
TRAFFIC DESIGN: one resident model at a time; the active role gets the whole GPU.
Batch by role to avoid model swaps.
